name: Matt Fleming
title: Lead Game Designer
quote: He developed into an amazing multifunctional designer who could do just about anything I threw at him, with a rare mix of creative and technical. If you need someone who can get features done, I can't recommend him enough.

name: Arron Ferguson
title: Lead Writer & Narrative Designer
quote: Percy is a fantastic Game Designer, as well as a true savant of UI/UX design. Incredibly proactive, he would often jump into my DMs with solutions to problems I didn't even know existed yet.

name: Emma Gallaher
title: Game Designer
quote: A creative powerhouse with an incredible work ethic. Percy has the ability to balance creative vision with systems thinking, which makes him an outstanding general designer.

name: Guilherme Martins
title: Technical Level Designer
quote: One of the most talented young professionals I've had the privilege to collaborate with. He encourages collaboration, lifts others up, and takes initiative even when faced with ambiguity.

name: David Slauenwhite
title: Indie GameDev, Producer & Designer
quote: A pleasure to work with, bringing solid insights into game design and UI/UX. Hard-working and consistent. As the producer tracking his projects, he delivered at or above expectations every time.

name: Joaquin Soriano
title: Engineer
quote: Easily one of the most versatile and dependable people I've worked with, across game design, UX/UI, project coordination, even programming support. His attention to user experience and design was especially impressive.

name: Renèe Camillo Pollet
title: Game Designer & Developer
quote: One of the most talented UI designers and game developers I've encountered. His passion is evident in every project he tackles, showing a proactiveness that is rarely seen.

name: Daril Camilo
title: Game Developer
quote: He has incredible skills across many game development specialties: programming, UI, 3D modelling and game design. An amazing talent so young, and just as capable leading a team.
